subject: Chemistry
unit: Unit XIII — d- and f-Block Elements
title: Potassium Permanganate (KMnO₄): Synthesis & Multi-pH Chemistry
topics: Industrial Synthesis from Pyrolusite Ore (MnO₂): KOH fusion to K₂MnO₄ (green) ──► Oxidation to KMnO₄ (purple)
Manganate (MnO₄²⁻, green, paramagnetic, 3d¹) vs Permanganate (MnO₄⁻, purple, diamagnetic, 3d⁰)
6.1 Multi-pH Oxidizing Behavior: Acidic (n=5, Mn²⁺ colorless), Neutral/Faintly Alkaline (n=3, MnO₂ brown ppt), Strongly Basic (n=1, MnO₄²⁻ green)
Special Alkaline/Neutral Reactions: Iodide to Iodate (I⁻ ──► IO₃⁻! NOT I₂!) & Thiosulfate to Sulfate (S₂O₃²⁻ ──► SO₄²⁻)
quickSummary: KMnO₄ is prepared by fusing MnO₂ with KOH + O₂ to green K₂MnO₄, followed by electrolytic/acidic oxidation to purple KMnO₄. MnO₄²⁻ is green/paramagnetic (3d¹); MnO₄⁻ is purple/diamagnetic (3d⁰). Oxidizing behavior: Acidic (n=5, Mn²⁺), Neutral/Faintly Alkaline (n=3, MnO₂, converts I⁻ to IO₃⁻ iodate), Strongly Basic (n=1, MnO₄²⁻).
summary: Master potassium permanganate synthesis, manganate vs permanganate properties, and pH-dependent redox reactions.

summaryBox.title: KMnO₄ Synthesis & Manganate vs Permanganate
summaryBox.takeaway: MnO₂ + KOH + O₂ ──► K₂MnO₄ (dark green, 3d¹, paramagnetic) ──► KMnO₄ (intense purple, 3d⁰, diamagnetic).

conceptBreakdown.codeSnippet:
POTASSIUM PERMANGANATE SYNTHESIS
                      
   1. Pyrolusite Fusion:   $2\text{MnO}_2 + 4\text{KOH} + \text{O}_2 \xrightarrow{\Delta} \mathbf{2\text{K}_2\text{MnO}_4 \text{ (Dark Green)}} + 2\text{H}_2\text{O}$
   2. Oxidation Step:      $3\text{MnO}_4^{2-} \text{ (Manganate)} + 4\text{H}^+ \longrightarrow \mathbf{2\text{MnO}_4^- \text{ (Purple Permanganate)}} + \text{MnO}_2 + 2\text{H}_2\text{O}$
                           *(Or via Anodic Electrolytic Oxidation: $\text{MnO}_4^{2-} \rightarrow \text{MnO}_4^- + e^-$)*

                        MANGANATE vs PERMANGANATE
                        
   Manganate Ion ($\text{MnO}_4^{2-}$):    Dark Green, Tetrahedral, Paramagnetic ($3d^1, \text{Mn} = +6$)
   Permanganate Ion ($\text{MnO}_4^-$):    Intense Purple, Tetrahedral, Diamagnetic ($3d^0, \text{Mn} = +7$)
conceptBreakdown.content:
Potassium permanganate is industrially synthesized from Pyrolusite ore ($\text{MnO}_2$):
1. **Fusion with $\text{KOH}$ and Air**: $2\text{MnO}_2 + 4\text{KOH} + \text{O}_2 \longrightarrow 2\text{K}_2\text{MnO}_4 + 2\text{H}_2\text{O}$.
2. **Disproportionation / Electrolytic Oxidation**: $3\text{MnO}_4^{2-} + 4\text{H}^+ \longrightarrow 2\text{MnO}_4^- + \text{MnO}_2 + 2\text{H}_2\text{O}$.

conceptBreakdown.heading: 6.1 Oxidizing Behavior Across pH Regimes
conceptBreakdown.title: 6.1 Oxidizing Behavior Across pH Regimes
conceptBreakdown.codeSnippet:
OXIDIZING BEHAVIOR ACROSS pH REGIMES

1. ACIDIC MEDIUM (pH < 7, n=5):
   MnO₄⁻ (+7) + 8H⁺ + 5e⁻ ──► Mn²⁺ (+2) (Colorless) + 4H₂O

2. NEUTRAL / FAINTLY ALKALINE (pH 7-9, n=3):
   MnO₄⁻ (+7) + 2H₂O + 3e⁻ ──► MnO₂ (+4) (Brown ppt) + 4OH⁻

3. STRONGLY BASIC (pH > 12, n=1):
   MnO₄⁻ (+7) + e⁻ ──► MnO₄²⁻ (+6) (Green Manganate)

Special Reactions in Neutral / Faintly Alkaline Medium (n=3):
• Iodide to Iodate:       MnO₄⁻ + I⁻ + H₂O ──► 2MnO₂↓ + IO₃⁻ (Iodate! NOT I₂!)
• Thiosulfate to Sulfate: 8MnO₄⁻ + 3S₂O₃²⁻ + H₂O ──► 8MnO₂↓ + 6SO₄²⁻ + 2OH⁻
conceptBreakdown.content:
- **Acidic Medium ($n=5$)**: $\text{MnO}_4^- + 8\text{H}^+ + 5e^- \longrightarrow \text{Mn}^{2+} + 4\text{H}_2\text{O}$.
- **Neutral / Faintly Alkaline Medium ($n=3$)**: $\text{MnO}_4^- + 2\text{H}_2\text{O} + 3e^- \longrightarrow \text{MnO}_2 + 4\text{OH}^-$.
  - **CRITICAL NEST TRAP**: In neutral/alkaline solution, $\text{I}^-$ is oxidized to **Iodate ($\text{IO}_3^-$)**, NOT $\text{I}_2$!
- **Strongly Basic Medium ($n=1$)**: $\text{MnO}_4^- + e^- \longrightarrow \text{MnO}_4^{2-}$.

quickRevision: MnO₄²⁻ is dark green, paramagnetic (3d¹); MnO₄⁻ is purple, diamagnetic (3d⁰).
Neutral / faintly alkaline: n-factor = 3 (MnO₄⁻ ──► MnO₂ brown ppt).
In neutral medium: I⁻ is oxidized to IO₃⁻ (Iodate!), NOT I₂.
